checkpoints.question: Which file in an ament_python ROS 2 package declares ROS dependencies?
checkpoints.model_answer: `package.xml` declares the package and its ROS dependencies. `setup.py` installs Python code and registers executable names.

checkpoints.question: Why should a command use `$COLCON_WS` instead of assuming `/code`?
checkpoints.model_answer: The environment variable makes the command work when a workspace is located somewhere other than `/code`.
